none: PAS FindID 985490: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), small module Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [---]S NOB C. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them, possibly small eagle atop a disc on standard. Revers inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 14.1mm, Weight: 1.28gms, die axis: 6
